text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- King Hassan meets Tunisian Prime Minister Hamed Karoui.
- United Nations extend the mission of peacekeeping forces in the disputed Western Sahara.
- President of French senate Rene Monory ends visit to Morocco.
- Minister of Privatisation Abderrahman Saaidi presents before the 333-seat parliament his point of view on the ongoing privatisation programme.
- Morocco signs a trade and tariff agreement with Tunisia.
- Morocco to introduce new firms on the Casablanca stock exchange.
